metadata.name: elite-county-zip-maps
metadata.description: Duval and Clay County geographic ZIP maps with hover highlighting, labels, keyboard and touch selection.
features: Census geographic ZIP polygons clipped to county boundaries
Vibrant blue, cyan, indigo and teal ZIP fills with an exact-path gold hover border
Higher-detail boundary geometry and raised active outline

events.name: zipSelect
events.description: A ZIP polygon or chip was selected

specifications: Loads public Census TIGERweb data on mount; requires browser access to tigerweb.geo.census.gov.
2020 ZCTAs clipped to 2026 county boundaries; non-geographic ZIPs have no polygon.
Map colors are geographic interaction cues, not CRM performance metrics.
No Podio connection required; ZIP selection emits an event but does not modify CRM records.
Hover overlay reuses the active ZIP polygon path with pointer-events disabled; adjacent polygons cannot cover the active border. Region colors are categorical, not scores.
